ARABIC LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Gist: Attentive Listening.

2. When practising Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.

3. When practising Reading Aloud: Arabic Alphabet, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Aloud: Arabic Alphabet.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Aloud: Arabic Alphabet.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading Aloud: Arabic Alphabet.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading Aloud: Arabic Alphabet.

4. When practising Phonological Awareness: Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)

5. When practising Conversational Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   C. Copy random text without understanding Conversational Skills.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Conversational Skills.

6. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.

7. In ARABIC LANGUAGE, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid speaking to classmates
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

8. When practising Imitative Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Imitative Speaking.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Imitative Speaking.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Imitative Speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Imitative Speaking.

9. When practising Public Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Public Speaking.

----
